input_output: OperationContext: trusted Caller, optional document/revision/profile/requested_version, idempotency key and request id; generated InputTraits bind operation version/schema/units to typed handlers.
ChangeReceipt: transaction, committed_revision/current_revision/content_state, replayed and primary_entity. HistorySnapshot: items/cursor/revision.
implemented_subset.errors_and_effects: Registry register_typed verifies InputTraits metadata and rejects empty handlers; invoke returns Result<Value>. Omitted requested_version is supported for trusted local/legacy callers, while incompatible explicit versions reject. Coordinator atomically validates context, commits history/store and preserves idempotency facts even after undo.

state_failure_version_rules: Reference evidence remains L1_draft. This file documents actual public declarations separately from design names; no fresh consumer/BP execution, L2 or full SK/P0 acceptance is asserted.
All document mutation uses the shared coordinator, document/epoch/revision checks and atomic persistent history; GUI/script/AI cannot bypass it.
Unimplemented advanced capabilities report unavailable; data/reference errors never become a partially committed model.
Design/acceptance obligation: Same-key/same-params retry returns original fact; same-key/different-params conflicts.
Design/acceptance obligation: Atomic DB/RAM publication prevents half/duplicate commits, including undo then replay of old successful request.
Design/acceptance obligation: BP-12 100 undo/redo cycles after one move have exact revision delta 201 and exact golden states.
Design/acceptance obligation: Persisted operation/delta/schema versions and history quotas govern recovery; unsupported versions reject.

Registry register_typed verifies InputTraits metadata and rejects empty handlers; invoke returns Result<Value>. Omitted requested_version is supported for trusted local/legacy callers, while incompatible explicit versions reject. Coordinator atomically validates context, commits history/store and preserves idempotency facts even after undo.
